ex.en: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allah is severe
By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly
And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason
They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic
